verdict.rationale: Anthropic documents that its skills follow the Agent Skills open standard, which 'works across multiple AI tools' and was published 'for cross-platform portability'. The skills are plain spec-conformant SKILL.md folders, and a hands-on probe installed one with generic tooling without an Anthropic account. However, the only documented install paths are Claude Code's plugin marketplace and the Claude API, and the probe itself targeted only claude-code. Missing for 10: per-harness install instructions for Codex, Cursor or other agents; first-party documentation of installing the collection into any non-Claude agent; independent verification that the skills work in other harnesses.
